description: Place an implicit mate connector on an instance by inference (CENTROID, TOP, ...). Its feature id is what onshape_assembly_mate then joins.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.
